errors.evidence: The description states '37. Dezember', which is incorrect; there is no 37th day in December.
The description implies 'Füllstandsvorgaben' are part of the graph, but it is only the current storage level that is highlighted.
The purpose of the chart, which is to show 'die Entwicklung der Gasspeicherfüllstände und Füllstandsvorgaben', is not clearly stated in terms of its significance.
The y-axis value range of the percentage is missing from the description.
The different colors of the lines and their corresponding years are misrepresented.
